answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in cedar, expire in vine, and terrace lists each expiry. Anyone running 51 aliases thus needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3314 identities would post 2577 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
